This is my partner's and my first mod, so feedback and recommendations are greatly appreciated! For customization and ore configuration, see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5966][color=#ffffff]Custom Ore Nodes.[/color][/url]

Downloads.Description:
Fixed Coal spawn rate.
Prismatic stone now drops 'prismatic pieces' instead of pirsmatic shards. Use prismatic pieces in the mineral processor to make shards.
All spawn levels and spawn rates adjusted.
Likes/Dislikes as well as sell prices adjusted.
